items.title: Do Agent Optimizers Compound? A Continual-Learning Evaluation on Terminal-Bench 2.0
items.title_zh: 智能体优化器会复利吗？Terminal-Bench 2.0 上的持续学习评估
items.summary: The paper runs a two-phase continual-learning evaluation on hard Terminal-Bench 2.0 tasks comparing GEPA, Meta Harness and RELAI-VCL under identical optimization budgets. All three beat the baseline in the static single-phase setting, but only RELAI-VCL both transferred positively to new tasks and kept improving after those tasks were added, reaching a lifelong average pass rate of 76.4% versus 66.0% for GEPA, 64.6% for Meta Harness and 58.7% for the baseline.

items.title: PersonaMem-v3: Toward Omni-Platform Personal Intelligence for Holistic User Understanding, Recommendation, and Agentic Tasks
items.title_zh: PersonaMem-v3：面向全平台个人智能的整体用户理解、推荐与智能体任务
items.summary: PersonaMem-v3 is a benchmark and evaluation harness for omni-platform personal intelligence, seeded from more than one million anonymized real-world engagement histories to construct time-indexed user digital worlds across social media, chatbot, calendar and AI-companion contexts with evolving preferences. It brings personalization, LLM-powered recommendation, proactiveness, agentic tool use and geo-temporal reasoning into one framework, including whether agents hold back when personalization would be inappropriate, repetitive, outdated or unnecessary.

items.title: AutoTrace: From Patches to Triggers via Agentic Interprocedural Exploration
items.title_zh: AutoTrace：通过智能体跨过程探索从补丁定位触发点
items.summary: AutoTrace is an agentic pipeline that localizes vulnerability triggers by exploring a code property graph layer by layer, with LLM agents deciding where to look next and deterministic admissibility gates requiring explicit evidence before a trigger is reported. It reaches 75.0% VulnHit and 80.8% FuncHit on the full InterPVD benchmark, and the authors also release SinkTrace-Bench with 1,542 verifier-confirmed, balanced vulnerable/safe samples.

items.title: Debate-on-Graph: Reliable and Adaptive Reasoning of Large Language Model on Uncertain Knowledge Graph
items.title_zh: Debate-on-Graph：不确定知识图谱上可靠且自适应的 LLM 推理
items.summary: Debate-on-Graph combines a heuristic search algorithm that extracts reliable, question-relevant subgraphs from uncertain knowledge graphs with a multi-agent debate mechanism that produces answers through adaptive adversarial debate. Experiments on four benchmark QA datasets are reported to achieve state-of-the-art performance over existing LLM reasoning methods and knowledge-graph-based baselines.

items.title: RECON: Benchmarking Agent Memory for Compositional Reasoning over Long Contexts
items.title_zh: RECON：评估智能体长上下文组合推理记忆能力的基准
items.summary: RECON is a benchmark of 24 case files spanning criminal, medical and financial domains, each 50k-100k tokens, testing six memory-intensive tasks such as reconstructing multi-hop evidence chains, propagating cascading invalidations and resolving source conflicts. The strongest non-Oracle system reaches only 22.4% accuracy, with retrieval and reasoning each surfacing as challenges.

items.title_zh: 智能体优化器会复利吗？Terminal-Bench 2.0 上的持续学习评估

items.title: Agora: Enhancing LLM Agent Reasoning Via Auction-Based Task Allocation
items.title_zh: Agora：通过拍卖式任务分配增强LLM智能体推理
items.summary: Agora proposes auction-based task allocation to coordinate multiple LLM agents for reasoning, dynamically assigning subtasks to specialized agents. The paper reports that the mechanism improves overall reasoning capability beyond single-agent approaches.

items.title: IDP AutoOpt: Agent-Driven Optimization of Document Processing Pipeline Configurations
items.title_zh: IDP AutoOpt：智能体驱动的文档处理流水线配置优化
items.summary: IDP AutoOpt is an autonomous LLM agent that tunes prompts, models, OCR settings, and schemas for intelligent document processing by scoring configurations, diagnosing field-level errors, and generating targeted edits in a closed loop. It reports matching or exceeding human-expert accuracy at equal or lower cost, with one extraction benchmark at 90.2% versus 81.6% and 4.6x lower per-page cost, while cutting configuration time from weeks to under two hours.

items.title: A Multi-Agent System for Autonomous, Fine-Tuning-Free Clinical Symptom Detection: Development and Validation Study
items.title_zh: Pythia：无需微调的自主多智能体临床症状检测系统
items.summary: Pythia is a multi-agent system running on a locally hosted open-weights model that autonomously writes and optimizes extraction prompts for clinical concepts without manual prompt engineering or fine-tuning. Across 72 signs and symptoms from 400 clinical notes, it reached mean sensitivity of 0.76 and specificity of 0.95, matching or exceeding a curated lexicon on both metrics for 20 of 62 directly comparable concepts.

items.title: Oracle Agent Memory as an Enterprise Memory Substrate for Long-Horizon AI Agents
items.title_zh: Oracle Agent Memory：面向长周期 AI 智能体的企业级记忆底座
items.summary: This report studies Oracle Agent Memory as a database-native memory substrate built on Oracle Database for long-horizon agents, organized around a memory lifecycle of ingestion, extraction, consolidation, retrieval, summarization and revision or removal. It reports 93.8% accuracy on LongMemEval and about 10.7x fewer tokens than flat-history baselines, with a layered architecture separating an active memory core from a passive store interface.

items.title: Automatic Hard Example Synthesis with Multi-Level Agentic Data Curation
items.title_zh: 自动困难样本合成：多层级智能体数据策管
items.summary: The paper proposes an automated agentic red-teaming framework that synthesizes difficult multimodal safety examples with an iterative strategy that proposes novel hypotheses and mutates past attempts, using an Architect agent, an image generator and a multi-level verification committee of LLM raters. Using the synthesized examples as in-context demonstrations via test-time retrieval reduced the false negative rate from 41.2% to 24.5% on a public image safety benchmark without human labeling.

items.title: NeuroGRIP: Retrieval-Augmented Graph Refinement for Knowledge-Grounded EEG Seizure Diagnosis
items.title_zh: NeuroGRIP：面向知识驱动的 EEG 癫痫诊断的检索增强图精炼
items.summary: NeuroGRIP builds a large domain-specific knowledge base from authoritative clinical guidelines and uses an LLM to extract structured biomedical entities and relations into a textual knowledge graph. It projects EEG node embeddings into the knowledge graph's semantic space and runs FAISS-based similarity search over triplets to score and prune medically implausible edges, improving seizure detection accuracy and interpretability on TUSZ and CHB-MIT.

items.title: Auditing Retrieval-Augmented LLM Hypotheses for Longitudinal Cell Painting Morphology
items.title_zh: 审计面向纵向 Cell Painting 形态学的检索增强 LLM 假设
items.summary: The paper presents an evaluation-first, retrieval-augmented framework that combines week-matched Cell Painting morphology deltas with retrieved perturbation neighbors, pathway context and literature evidence through stable evidence identifiers, producing provenance-preserving biological hypotheses. Two auditing tests check citation validity and morphology compatibility on a 9-week RPE-1 time course; no invalid evidence references were detected, and compatibility increased with perturbation strength.

items.title: PANOPTICON: A PII-Based Assemblage of Naturalistic Output Tokens for Investigating Privacy Leakage Within LLM Context Window
items.title_zh: PANOPTICON：用于研究 LLM 上下文窗口隐私泄露的 PII 自然输出令牌数据集
items.summary: PANOPTICON is a pipeline and dataset of 67,718 prompts containing PII spans derived from 9,674 publicly available synthetic user profiles and generated with Meta's Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, intended for studying privacy leakage in the LLM context window. The authors measure lexical and S-BERT diversity and present a case study on prompt inversion attacks.

items.title: WordPolo: Evaluating Language Models Through Iterative Semantic Feedback
items.title_zh: WordPolo：通过迭代语义反馈评估语言模型
items.summary: WordPolo is a word-finding task in which models must discover an unknown target word from semantic-similarity distance scores, making iterative reasoning and adaptive search strategies directly observable. Across 1,500 puzzles, solve rates range from 4% to 62%, and progression-based metrics show reasoning models can be hindered by overthinking and underthinking while successful models exhibit human-like strategies.

items.title: SAGA: Synthetic Agentic Graph Architecture for Temporal Benchmark Generation
items.title_zh: SAGA：面向时序基准生成的合成智能体图架构
items.summary: SAGA generates large-scale, semantically rich temporal graphs through a four-phase skeleton-first, semantics-second pipeline in which LLM agents inject domain semantics using RAG-based rule bases and a state alignment engine resolves conflicts via temporal replay, yielding anomaly labels as a byproduct. On a single H100 GPU with vLLM batching it generates 500,000 temporal edges with controlled anomalies in under 90 minutes, scaling to 100,000 nodes while maintaining clustering coefficients above 0.99.

items.title: An Empirical Analysis of Continual Learning for Heterogeneous Medical Visual Question Answering
items.title_zh: 异构医学视觉问答持续学习的实证分析
items.summary: The paper systematically evaluates continual learning for medical visual question answering across classification, multi-label classification, detection, cell counting, and report generation. It finds that existing methods struggle to maintain a stability-plasticity balance when tasks with different objectives and supervision formats are interleaved, and analyzes task-order sensitivity and LoRA weight drift.

items.title: MET: Theory-Grounded and Culture-Aware Multilingual Moral Reasoning
items.title_zh: MET：理论锚定且文化感知的多语言道德推理
items.summary: The paper introduces MCLASH, a multilingual moral decision-making benchmark, and MET, a two-step prompting method that first selects situation- and culture-specific theory-based grounds and then reasons over them in the user's native language. MET-D self-distillation improves macro-F1 by an average of 3.71 points on MCLASH and 4.23 on MMoralExceptQA across three models, with a peak MCLASH gain of 12.94 points for Malay on Qwen3-8B.

items.title: Do AI Agents Know When a Task Is Simple? Toward Complexity-Aware Reasoning and Execution
items.title_zh: AI 智能体知道任务有多简单吗？迈向复杂度感知的推理与执行
items.summary: The paper argues that agents lack task-aware execution-scope estimation and formalizes minimum-sufficient execution plus an Agent Cognitive Redundancy Ratio, proposing E3 (Estimate, Execute, Expand) to expand scope only when verification fails. On MSE-Bench, E3 matched the strongest baseline's 100% success while cutting cost by 85%, tokens by 91% and inspected files by 92%, and a companion harness on a live gpt-4o agent found the over-reading milder but real.

items.title: GSM-Plus-BN: A Perturbation-Based Benchmark for Bangla Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models
items.title_zh: GSM-Plus-BN：面向大模型孟加拉语数学推理的扰动基准
items.summary: GSM-Plus-BN is a perturbed Bengali mathematical reasoning dataset derived from the English GSM-Plus benchmark and verified by human translators; six open-source LLMs were evaluated on 9,000 samples under standard and chain-of-thought prompting. GPT-OSS-20B achieved the highest seed-question accuracy at 96.08%, larger models were more robust across perturbation types, and a performance gap relative to English benchmarks persisted.

items.title: AI-accelerated End-to-End Framework for Rapid Professional Upskilling
items.title_zh: AI 加速的端到端专业能力提升框架
items.summary: The paper presents an end-to-end framework that applies AI acceleration across five stages of professional upskilling: knowledge acquisition, content development, content review and verification, teaching, and assessment development. External signals include approval of a program built on the framework for continuing-professional-education credits, three learners passing the NVIDIA Certified Professional in Agentic AI exam, and a 1,267-item risk dataset produced from the program's knowledge base.

items.title: Multi-Head Latent Control: A Unified Interface for LLM Agent Decision Making
items.title_zh: 多头潜在控制：LLM 智能体决策的统一接口
items.summary: Multi-Head Latent Control is a lightweight layer that reads hidden-state trajectories from a frozen LLM or VLM to produce deployment-time control signals, with a Capability Head for deferral to a stronger model and a Resolution Head for clarification, tool use, abstention or direct answering. In routed small-plus-large execution it reduces large-model usage by up to 90.7% on AndroidWorld and 27-53% on average across benchmarks while retaining most large-model performance.

items.title: BrainPilot: Automating Brain Discovery with Agentic Research
items.title_zh: BrainPilot：以智能体研究自动化大脑发现
items.summary: BrainPilot is a fully open-source multi-agent system in which a principal-investigator agent coordinates specialist agents grounded in a curated brain science knowledge base of 7,233 indexed items and a skill library of 72 reusable methodology units across seven research domains. Every major step is recorded in a Graph of Trace, an Auditor agent adds fabrication checking, and evaluations on three Agents' Last Exam brain science tasks plus BrainPilotBench-v0 report performance comparable to state-of-the-art agent frameworks at lower cost with an open-source backbone.

items.title: Precise but Uncoupled: Reviewer Precision Does Not Guarantee Critique Uptake in Multi-Agent Math Reasoning
items.title_zh: 精准却脱节：评审精度并不保证多智能体数学推理中的批评采纳
items.summary: The paper tests hierarchical reviewer designs on 4,181 verifier-grounded Omni-MATH problems with matched gpt-oss-120b actors and finds that from tier 4 onward broadcast-style peer discussion reaches higher final accuracy than a planner-executor-reviewer pipeline. The pipeline's reviewer was more precise (0.861 vs. 0.644), yet its verified useful critique was much less likely to change the next candidate, showing that reviewer detection quality and critique uptake are empirically separable.

items.title: Chronofy: A Temporal-Logical Decay Architecture for Information Validity in Time-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.title_zh: Chronofy：面向时间感知 RAG 信息有效性的时序逻辑衰减架构
items.summary: Chronofy is a three-layer neuro-symbolic framework that embeds temporal validity into the representation, retrieval and reasoning layers of RAG, reserving a temporal subspace in Matryoshka embeddings, adding learnable exponential decay to graph retrieval, and using Signal Temporal Logic robustness to bound confidence by the most decayed evidence. Evaluated on temporal knowledge graph forecasting and the TimE temporal QA benchmark, it is reported to improve retrieval precision and reduce temporal hallucination.

items.title: From Plausible to Actionable: A Position on LLM Self-Explanations
items.title_zh: 从可信到可行动：关于 LLM 自我解释的立场论文
items.summary: Researchers at xAI argue that LLM self-explanations can be plausible yet unfaithful, and propose that evaluation should extend beyond plausibility to actionability for real-world decision-making.

items.title: Beyond Memory Leaderboards: Evaluating Scientific Memory as Budgeted Context Restoration
items.title_zh: 超越记忆排行榜：将科学记忆评估为有预算的上下文恢复
items.summary: The paper introduces two full-text scientific-memory benchmarks, PAIM with 81 papers and 66 questions and PTr with 252 papers and 98 questions, and evaluates eight memory or retrieval systems plus a no-retrieval baseline. It reports that rankings depend on ingestion granularity, raw-text preservation, retrieval budget, modality and judge choice; on PAIM Graphiti's lead disappears after controlling for its 2.6M characters of retrieved context per query, and hybrid sparse-dense retrieval is the most significant intervention on PTr.

items.title: Though Language Models Err While They Strive: Conformal Prediction for Self-Correcting Scientific Generation
items.title_zh: 语言模型在努力中犯错：面向自校正科学生成的一致性预测
items.summary: Scientific Feasibility Control is a graph-structured conformal prediction framework that decomposes scientific reasoning into atomic factuality units requiring both correctness against physical laws and logical support from preceding context, branching to alternative generation paths when violations are detected. It reports 50.1% accuracy on PhyX multimodal physics, 91.7% scientific validity at alpha of 0.10 and 73% fewer scientific law violations across multiple model architectures.

items.title: Adapting Embedding Models for Agent Capability Retrieval
items.title_zh: 面向智能体能力检索的嵌入模型适配
items.summary: The study fine-tunes three open retrieval backbones, BGE-base, KaLM-v1.5 and EasyRec, on AgentSelect, which represents marketplace-visible agents, tool bundles and reusable skill packages as capability profiles derived from public metadata. Adaptation improves matching on two catalogs unseen during training, MuleRun native agents and a ClawHub benchmark of 50 skills with 1,000 queries, and code and data are to be released upon publication.

items.title: EvolvingWorld: An Open-Schema Framework for Co-Evolving Role-Play Agents and World Model in Interactive Literary World
items.title_zh: EvolvingWorld：交互式文学世界中角色智能体与世界模型协同演化的开放模式框架
items.summary: EvolvingWorld is an open-schema framework and benchmark that models interactive literary simulation as a long-horizon process, with a Character Agent for multi-character role-play and persistent profile evolution and an LLM-based World Model for global and location/entity-level state maintenance. Built from 57 books into 138,596 supervised training samples and 222 test snapshots, it reports improved long-horizon coherence under a 10-dimension, 20-metric LLM-as-judge protocol.

items.title: Poor Man's Agentic Modeling: Simulating Large LLM-Agent Societies on a Laptop
items.title_zh: Poor Man's Agentic Modeling：在笔记本电脑上模拟大规模 LLM 智能体社会
items.summary: The paper replaces each LLM agent in a large society simulation with a low-parameter surrogate fitted from a few hundred to a few thousand cheap queries, then runs the society at any agent count on a laptop. An interaction-order by memory taxonomy predicts how surrogate error scales with the number of agents, and the predictions are validated on a reimplementation of the EconAgent macroeconomy and seven further named LLM simulations, with two refuted predictions also matched quantitatively.

items.title: KlaatAI/klaatcode
items.title_zh: Klaatcode：开源终端 AI 编码助手，支持多模型智能路由
items.summary: Klaatcode is an open-source terminal AI coding agent that supports Claude, GPT, Gemini and DeepSeek models with smart routing, and is reportedly able to cut costs 10x while approaching Claude Code-grade accuracy.

items.title: NullLabTests/software-periodic-table
items.title_zh: 软件元素周期表：115 个可复用软件元素及 LLM 编码智能体组合框架
items.summary: software-periodic-table is a TypeScript library that defines a finite ontology of 115 recurring software elements and provides a composition framework for LLM-based coding agents to assemble software components systematically.

items.title: Mach-Mind-4-Flash Technical Report
items.title_zh: Mach-Mind-4-Flash 技术报告：35B MoE 智能体模型发布
items.summary: Mach-Mind-4-Flash is a 35B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts agentic model with 3B activated parameters. Its technical report describes an agentic LLM designed for tool use and complex reasoning tasks.

items.title: Agent era day 500: why we should stop investing in GUI-thinking software
items.title_zh: Agent 元年 500 天：为什么我们不该再投资 GUI 思维的软件
items.summary: A 500-day retrospective on the AI agent era examines the paradigm shift away from GUI-centric software toward agent-native architectures and interaction models.

items.title: Doubao vs WorkBuddy vs QoderWork: 8 real office tasks benchmark three desktop AI agents
items.title_zh: 豆包、WorkBuddy、QoderWork 横向对比：8 个真实办公任务实测三大桌面 Agent
items.summary: A hands-on comparison benchmarks ByteDance's Doubao, WorkBuddy and QoderWork across eight real-world office productivity tasks to assess the capabilities of three leading desktop AI agents.

items.title: How to manage AI investments in the agentic era
items.title_zh: 智能体时代如何管理 AI 投资
items.summary: OpenAI outlines how enterprises can manage AI investments in the agentic era by measuring useful work per dollar, improving efficiency and scaling high-value workflows.

items.title: GPT-Red: Unlocking Self-Improvement for Robustness
items.title_zh: GPT-Red：以自我博弈解锁鲁棒性自我改进
items.summary: OpenAI describes GPT-Red, an automated red-teaming system that uses self-play to improve AI safety, alignment and prompt-injection robustness.

items.title: How Cars24 scales conversations and builds faster with OpenAI
items.title_zh: Cars24 如何借助 OpenAI 扩展对话并加速构建
items.summary: Cars24 uses OpenAI-powered voice and chat agents to handle more than 1 million monthly conversation minutes, recover 12% of lost leads and bring agentic workflows to teams across the company.

items.title: How Codex became a collaborator for OpenAI’s creative team
items.title_zh: Codex 如何成为 OpenAI 创意团队的协作伙伴
items.summary: OpenAI's creative team uses Codex to build custom creative tools, accelerate ideation and prototype faster with context-aware AI.

items.title: Huawei Cloud Unveils Enterprise AI at WAIC: Zhou Yuefeng Breaks Down the Steps for Scaling AI Agents Into Production Systems
items.title_zh: 华为云在 WAIC 发布企业级 AI：周跃峰详解智能体规模化落地路径
items.summary: Huawei Cloud CEO Zhou Yuefeng introduced the AgentArts platform and openJiuwen framework at WAIC 2026, aimed at enterprise-grade AI agent deployment with multi-agent coordination, stability and security guarantees.
